Models

class models.InstanceRigidModelLOG(timepoints, reg_weight=0.001, cost='l1', device='cpu', torch_dtype=torch.float32)[source]

Bases: Module

Instance-specific rigid registration via log-space parameterisation.

Jointly estimates per-timepoint rigid transformations by minimising the discrepancy between predicted and observed pairwise log-rigid transforms. Rotation and translation are stored as Lie-algebra elements and converted to 4×4 matrices via the matrix exponential.

N

Number of timepoints.

Type:

int

K

Number of pairwise combinations N*(N-1)//2.

Type:

int

angle

Lie-algebra rotation vector per timepoint, shape (3, N).

Type:

torch.nn.Parameter

translation

Translation vector per timepoint, shape (3, N).

Type:

torch.nn.Parameter

forward(logRobs, timepoints)[source]

Compute the fitting loss between predicted and observed pairwise transforms.

Parameters:

  • logRobs (torch.Tensor) – Observed pairwise log-rigid vectors, shape (6, K).

  • timepoints (list) – Ordered timepoints used to index parameters.

Returns:

Scalar loss value.

Return type:

torch.Tensor

Raises:

ValueError – If self.cost is not 'l1' or 'l2'.

class models.ST2Nonlinear(obs_size, cp_size, factor=2, cost='l1', timepoints=None, init_T=None, reg_weight=1, version=0, device='cpu')[source]

Bases: Module

Spatio-temporal squared (ST²) nonlinear registration model.

Estimates per-timepoint stationary velocity fields (SVFs) on a control-point grid that minimise discrepancy between predicted and observed pairwise deformation fields.

N

Number of timepoints.

Type:

int

K

Number of pairwise combinations N*(N-1)//2.

Type:

int

T

Per-timepoint SVFs keyed by timepoint ID, each of shape (1, 3, *cp_size).

Type:

torch.nn.ParameterDict

forward(R, tid_list, M=None)[source]

Compute the fitting loss between predicted and observed pairwise fields.

Parameters:

  • R (torch.Tensor) – Observed pairwise displacement fields, shape (*obs_size, 3, K).

  • tid_list (list of str) – Pairs in 'ref_to_flo' format.

  • M (torch.Tensor, optional) – Spatial weight mask applied to the residuals. If None, all voxels contribute equally.

Returns:

Scalar loss value.

Return type:

torch.Tensor

Raises:

ValueError – If self.cost is not 'l1' or 'l2'.
